rv.q: Unpolished but intriguing triptych of interwoven monologues tackling themes of consumerism
I cannot recommend this play highly enough. Simply unmissable.
This is bold, experimental theatre at its finest and the tumultuous applause that greets the final chord is evidence that tonight’s audience has been just as thrilled as I am.

Meg Lewis puts in one of the most impressive performances I've seen in a long while, managing to create such distinct personalities that the flashing ticker-tape showing their names was hardly needed.

cn.t: Critics hail Billie Collins' riveting new play as ambitious, cutting-edge theatre that keeps audiences on the edge of their seats, with particular praise for its ingenious set design and powerful emotional impact.
